statements.statement:
theorem after_eq_before (request : Result Outcome) (w : host_weights.Weights) (kappa : E) :
    (request >>= fun event => PV_B2_F_MaterializeFrozen.original event w kappa) =
      original request w kappa

theorem complete_result (request : Result Outcome) (w : host_weights.Weights) (kappa : E) :
    PV_B2_F_AllocationEffects.copied request w kappa = original request w kappa

theorem source (base : ProverRwFull.ExternalTypes) (request : Result Outcome)
    (ops : @ProverRwFull.ExternalFuns (types base)) (w : W) (kappa : Native) :
    @ProverRwFull.ExternalFuns.op251 (types base) (selected base request ops) w kappa =
      PV_B2_E_OrdinaryOriginal.mapResult mapRust
        (PV_B2_F_MaterializeRequest.original request w (fromNative kappa))

theorem nonvacuity (base : ProverRwFull.ExternalTypes)
    (ops : @ProverRwFull.ExternalFuns (types base)) (w : W) (kappa : Native) :
    ∃ out, @ProverRwFull.ExternalFuns.op251 (types base)
      (selected base (ok .supplied) ops) w kappa = ok (.Ok out)

theorem allocation_error (base : ProverRwFull.ExternalTypes)
    (ops : @ProverRwFull.ExternalFuns (types base)) (w : W) (kappa : Native) :
    @ProverRwFull.ExternalFuns.op251 (types base)
      (selected base (ok .denied) ops) w kappa = ok (.Err ProverRwFull.verifier.Error.Allocation)

theorem failure (base : ProverRwFull.ExternalTypes) (e : Error)
    (ops : @ProverRwFull.ExternalFuns (types base)) (w : W) (kappa : Native) :
    @ProverRwFull.ExternalFuns.op251 (types base)
      (selected base (fail e) ops) w kappa = fail e

theorem divergence (base : ProverRwFull.ExternalTypes)
    (ops : @ProverRwFull.ExternalFuns (types base)) (w : W) (kappa : Native) :
    @ProverRwFull.ExternalFuns.op251 (types base)
      (selected base div ops) w kappa = div

theorem three_rows (base : ProverRwFull.ExternalTypes) (request : Result Outcome)
    (ops : @ProverRwFull.ExternalFuns (types base))
    (b : PV_B2_E_OrdinaryOriginal.Bytes) (w : W) (kappa : Native) :
    @ProverRwFull.ExternalFuns.op249 (types base) (selected base request ops) b =
      PV_B2_E_OrdinaryOriginal.mapResult PV_B2_E_OrdinaryOriginal.toNative
        (PV_B2_E_GammaOriginal.originalGamma b) ∧
    @ProverRwFull.ExternalFuns.op250 (types base) (selected base request ops) b =
      PV_B2_E_OrdinaryOriginal.mapResult PV_B2_E_OrdinaryOriginal.toNative
        (PV_B2_E_OrdinaryOriginal.original b) ∧
    @ProverRwFull.ExternalFuns.op251 (types base) (selected base request ops) w kappa =
      PV_B2_E_OrdinaryOriginal.mapResult mapRust
        (PV_B2_F_MaterializeRequest.original request w (fromNative kappa))

ambient_context: Every base ExternalTypes; op25 instantiated to the exact four-field weights structure. Every request : Result Outcome, ops in that carrier, weight and native kappa. No success/canonicality/source-equality premise.
nonvacuity: All weights/kappas succeed for ok supplied. ok denied yields exactly native Error::Allocation; fail e and div are preserved. Source kernel success is unconditional. This does not assert every native allocation succeeds.
native_link_evidence_class: Reviewed structural source/caller argument plus universal Lean Result equality for every allocation-request context and exact selected native-carrier installation; not fresh Aeneas extraction of the original mutable iterator and not a native execution/OS proof
native_limits: Selected candidate source/callback row only; the request is universally quantified, not a new trust item or success premise. Actual native RunJoin installation, OS-failure witness independence and L1/L2/L3 remain P obligations.
